discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 to 250_b080/274_b128; reuses their keys (Mei key from 276_b130 lead). 29 standard searches, all snippets. Added 8 pins: Mei Red Panda Costume (BoxLunch, Sep 2023), WALL-E Date Night LE (Mar 2023) and its 4-piece set (4 named pins), Three Good Fairies Stained Glass LE 1,900 (Nov 2023), Cinderella Princess Series lenticular LE 1,300 (Jun 2023). Added 4 Hot Topic Loungefly blind-box sets (Map, Mickey Western, Pooh Western, Halloween 2023) with members held. Corroborated Oogie Boogie NYCC (edition conflict), Ep1-2-3 date, Stained Glass Portrait size 6, Candy Boxes films, Heffa/Soda dates. No existing hold released.
